_comment: Playable and world races. Primary adjustments are added to class stats; modifiers are always-on racial traits. Race ids are content, never special-cased in Python. Sub-races add unique bonus traits and stats.

races.name: Human
races.description: Adaptable people found in every settlement and profession.
traits: Versatile: no fixed strengths or penalties
Open Roads: no culture treats you as wholly unfamiliar

sub_races.name: Lowlander
sub_races.description: From the fertile plains, traders and farmers by heritage.
bonus_traits: Trade Tongue: better prices in human settlements

sub_races.name: Highlander
sub_races.description: Mountain-born, hardened by wind and altitude.
bonus_traits: Mountain Blood: resistant to cold and fatigue

sub_races.name: Seafarer
sub_races.description: Coastal people who read tides like others read books.
bonus_traits: Sea Legs: improved balance and agility

races.name: Elf
races.description: Long-lived keepers of songs that remember landscapes before roads.
traits: Keen Senses: improved accuracy and evasion
Long Memory: strong affinity for magic and old places

sub_races.name: High Elf
sub_races.description: Scholars of the silver towers, masters of arcane theory.
bonus_traits: Arcane Heritage: enhanced magical aptitude

sub_races.name: Wood Elf
sub_races.description: Forest-dwelling hunters and pathfinders.
bonus_traits: Forest Stride: move silently through natural terrain

sub_races.name: Drow
sub_races.description: Underdark elves, marked by shadow and suspicion.
bonus_traits: Shadow Sight: see in darkness, feared by surface dwellers

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description: Heirs to two histories, frequently asked to explain both and belonging fully to neither.
traits: Between Worlds: increased status resistance
Quick Study: balanced physical and magical aptitude

sub_races.name: Noble-Born
sub_races.description: Raised in courts, trained in diplomacy and intrigue.
bonus_traits: Courtly Grace: advantage in social encounters

sub_races.name: Wanderer
sub_races.description: Road-raised, belonging everywhere and nowhere.
bonus_traits: Road Wisdom: survival instincts and adaptability

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Stonewise clans whose promises are expected to outlast the halls where they were made.
traits: Stoneborn: increased armour and health
Unyielding: improved resistance to hostile effects

sub_races.name: Mountain Dwarf
sub_races.description: High-altitude miners and warriors, toughest of the tough.
bonus_traits: Deep Rooted: nearly impossible to knock down

sub_races.name: Hill Dwarf
sub_races.description: Surface-dwelling farmers and craftspeople, more sociable.
bonus_traits: Clan Bonds: stronger community ties

sub_races.name: Forge Dwarf
sub_races.description: Master smiths who live by the anvil's heat.
bonus_traits: Fire-Touched: resistant to heat and flame

races.name: Dragonkin
races.description: Scaled descendants of old draconic pacts, carrying heat in their blood and pride in their posture.
traits: Scaled Hide: increased physical and magical defence
Drakeblood: increased physical power

sub_races.name: Red Dragonkin
sub_races.description: Fire-blooded, fierce and proud, drawn to flame and conquest.
bonus_traits: Fire Breath: innate flame attack, immune to fire

sub_races.name: Gold Dragonkin
sub_races.description: Noble and wise, guardians of ancient oaths.
bonus_traits: Draconic Majesty: inspiring presence, resistant to fear

sub_races.name: Blue Dragonkin
sub_races.description: Storm-touched, quick and cunning, masters of lightning.
bonus_traits: Lightning Reflexes: enhanced speed and reaction

races.name: Demon
races.description: People of the Ash Courts, defined by fierce contracts rather than the frightening stories told about them.
traits: Ashborn: increased magical force
Dangerous Ambition: greater critical damage at the cost of resilience

sub_races.name: Pit Fiend
sub_races.description: Brutal warriors of the lower courts, strength over subtlety.
bonus_traits: Infernal Might: devastating melee attacks

sub_races.name: Succubus/Incubus
sub_races.description: Charmers and manipulators, wielding allure as a weapon.
bonus_traits: Enthralling: charm and persuasion enhanced

sub_races.name: Balor
sub_races.description: Wreathed in flame and shadow, destruction incarnate.
bonus_traits: Flame Aura: burns those who strike you

races.name: Tiefling
races.description: Mortal bloodlines touched by the outer realms, marked by horns, tails, unusual eyes, and endless assumptions.
traits: Planar Blood: increased magic resistance
Devil's Luck: increased critical chance

sub_races.name: Infernal Tiefling
sub_races.description: Devil-blooded, marked by order and contracts.
bonus_traits: Hellish Resistance: immune to fire and poison

sub_races.name: Abyssal Tiefling
sub_races.description: Demon-touched, chaotic and unpredictable.
bonus_traits: Abyssal Fury: damage increases when wounded

races.name: Beastkin
races.description: Many furred, feathered, and keen-eared peoples joined by shared migration routes rather than one ancestry.
traits: Wild Instinct: increased speed and evasion
Hunter's Blood: increased critical chance

sub_races.name: Feline
sub_races.description: Cat-folk, graceful and independent, with night vision.
bonus_traits: Feline Grace: always land on your feet, see in darkness

sub_races.name: Canine
sub_races.description: Wolf-folk, loyal pack hunters with keen senses.
bonus_traits: Pack Tactics: bonuses when fighting with allies

sub_races.name: Avian
sub_races.description: Bird-folk, swift and keen-eyed, some can glide.
bonus_traits: Keen Sight: enhanced perception and ranged accuracy

races.name: Orc
races.description: Fierce warriors of the steppes, bound by honour and blood-oath.
traits: Blood Fury: damage increases when wounded
War Born: natural fighters from birth

sub_races.name: Half-Orc
sub_races.description: Straddling two worlds, tougher than most humans and cleverer than most orcs.
bonus_traits: Dual Heritage: accepted in more places than full-bloods

sub_races.name: War Orc
sub_races.description: Bred for battle, stronger and fiercer than their kin.
bonus_traits: Battle Rage: bonus damage below half health

sub_races.name: Shaman Orc
sub_races.description: Spirit-callers who commune with ancestral totems.
bonus_traits: Ancestor Bond: enhanced spiritual magic

races.name: Gnome
races.description: Small inventors and tinkerers whose curiosity is exceeded only by their explosions.
traits: Tinker: bonus to crafting and mechanical devices
Curious Mind: faster skill learning

sub_races.name: Rock Gnome
sub_races.description: Inventors of clockwork marvels and alchemical wonders.
bonus_traits: Alchemical Mind: resistance to poison and acid

sub_races.name: Forest Gnome
sub_races.description: Reclusive illusionists who befriend woodland creatures.
bonus_traits: Natural Illusionist: innate minor illusion magic

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small folk with great luck and greater appetites.
traits: Halfling Luck: supernatural good fortune
Small Frame: harder to hit

sub_races.name: Lightfoot
sub_races.description: Sociable and stealthy, able to hide behind anyone taller.
bonus_traits: Naturally Stealthy: can hide behind creatures one size larger

sub_races.name: Stout
sub_races.description: Hardier than most halflings, with dwarven resilience.
bonus_traits: Stout Resilience: resistant to poison

races.name: Genasi
races.description: Mortals touched by the elemental planes, carrying fire, water, earth, or air in their blood.
traits: Elemental Heritage: innate connection to the planes
Planar Adaptation: balanced stats

sub_races.name: Fire Genasi
sub_races.description: Flame-haired and hot-tempered, wreathed in perpetual warmth.
bonus_traits: Fire Resistance: immune to flame damage

sub_races.name: Water Genasi
sub_races.description: Flowing and adaptable, at home in any body of water.
bonus_traits: Amphibious: breathe water and land equally

sub_races.name: Earth Genasi
sub_races.description: Solid and unyielding, with stone-like skin and deep patience.
bonus_traits: Stone Skin: natural armour bonus

sub_races.name: Air Genasi
sub_races.description: Quick and mercurial, lighter on their feet than gravity suggests.
bonus_traits: Unbound: can slow falls and resist wind

races.name: Goliath
races.description: Giant-kin who live among the peaks, measuring worth in deeds rather than words.
traits: Stone's Endurance: shrug off damage once per battle
Mountain Born: acclimated to altitude and cold

sub_races.name: Frost Goliath
sub_races.description: Peak-dwelling giants adapted to extreme cold.
bonus_traits: Frost Touched: immune to cold damage

sub_races.name: Storm Goliath
sub_races.description: Thunder-voiced giants who live where lightning strikes.
bonus_traits: Thunder Clap: innate shockwave ability

races.name: Lamia
races.description: Serpentine people with humanoid torsos and powerful coils, ancient and wise.
traits: Serpentine Grace: constrict attacks and enhanced grappling
Ancient Wisdom: bonus to magical learning

sub_races.name: Naga Lamia
sub_races.description: Royal serpents with innate magical abilities.
bonus_traits: Innate Sorcery: natural spellcasting ability

sub_races.name: Hunter Lamia
sub_races.description: Predatory coils built for ambush and constriction.
bonus_traits: Constrict: bonus grappling and restraint

races.name: Arachne
races.description: Spider-folk with humanoid upper bodies and arachnid lower halves, weavers of fate and silk.
traits: Web Weaver: create silk traps and bindings
Wall Walker: climb any surface

sub_races.name: Weaver Arachne
sub_races.description: Artisan spider-folk whose silk becomes art and armour.
bonus_traits: Silk Artisan: craft superior silk items

sub_races.name: Predator Arachne
sub_races.description: Hunting spiders, patient ambush predators with venom.
bonus_traits: Venomous Bite: innate poison attack
